name: OpenBlast v2.0.2.1
highlights: Persistent Media Notification: Your playback controls now stay pinned in the status bar even when paused or cleared from recent apps, allowing instant resume anytime.
Listen Together Built-in QR Scanner: Join rooms by pointing your camera at your friend's screen with the new in-app QR scanner—no browser redirects required.
Jam & Blends Room Suggestions: Recommend songs directly for specific friends in the room with clean attribution badges showing who picked each track.
Update Dialog Snooze: Choose 'Remind in 3 days' when a new update notification appears to snooze prompts for 72 hours without interrupting your listening.
Enhanced Volume Boost: Cleaner volume amplification with balanced preamplification and soft-limiting across headphones and speakers.
Live Lyrics Animation Preview: Interactive preview screen in Lyrics Settings to test and preview every motion effect in real time.
Clean Vector Badges: Streamlined modern icons replacing emojis across the player and queue.

name: OpenBlast v2.0.2
highlights: [Persistent Playlist Backup] Playlists, stars, and library saved to Documents/OpenBlast/backups; automatically survives uninstalls and restores on reinstall
[Notification Bar Playback Fix] Instant playback start/resume directly from the pinned media notification even after clearing app from recent apps
[200% VLC Volume Boost] Smooth audio boost up to 200% (+6 dB) with built-in soft limiting in Remix sheet and Equalizer settings
[Listen Together Jam & Blends] Instagram Blends-style song attribution badges ('✨ Suggested for' / '🎧 Picked by') in real-time rooms and queues

name: OpenBlast v2.0.1 (Android TV Edition)
highlights: [Android TV & Google TV] Dedicated 10-foot Leanback interface optimized for TV remotes and D-pad navigation
[Remote Seeking & Control] Precision directional navigation with instant play, pause, and track hopping
[QR Code Sign-In] Pair instantly with phone without on-screen TV keyboard typing
[High-Fidelity Audio] 48 kHz Opus direct DAC playback for home theaters and soundbars
[Downloader Sideload] Fully compatible with Downloader app and USB sideloading on all Android TV boxes

name: OpenBlast v1.0.5 (iOS Edition)

[SwiftUI Native Player] Fluid gesture-driven interface designed specifically for iOS 16 and iOS 17/18

[AirPlay & Lock Screen] Integrated Now Playing info center, Control Center scrubbing, and AirPlay 2 streaming
[Source Catalog] Direct SideStore repository URL: https://openblast.vercel.app/ios/source.json
